reasoning_summary: The fix adds a conditional check (arg == null ? "null" : arg.toString()) to handle the null case before calling a method on the object. This is a classic missing guard/validation check, which falls under the 'Checking' category.
evidence_used: The stack trace shows a NullPointerException.
